content: Multiplayer quiz data model pattern: Room/Session entity (join code, host ref, status, current question index) isolates all state per game; Player entities scoped to a room (nickname, socket/connection id, score, answered flags) never leak across rooms; Quiz/Question/Option entities are host-owned templates reused across many room instances; Answer/Response entities record per-player per-question submissions (choice, response time, correctness, points awarded) for scoring and leaderboard aggregation.
